attributes.author: Max Gomez
attributes.message: "ScaleTech was instrumental in the conceptualizing and launching of Breathwrk. We might not be here today without them. They took time to fully understand my vision and advised me as I embarked on a journey to develop a software application that would be groundbreaking in the area of mindfulness and behavioral therapy. From a development perspective, they provide a true full-stack skill matrix with an agile, iterative development mindset. They always deliver quality, on time, within budget, with timely support."

attributes.message: “I've used ScaleTech over the years at both Whow Games for slot development, and now again for all of Oxolo AI products. Supplementing Scaletech as an extension of my in-house team allows me to scale and accelerate projects with quality code and on-time deliverables. They're honest, easy to work with, and reliable. I'm very satisfied with the outcomes of our continued development partnership.”

attributes.author: Brad Boim
attributes.message: “The Scaletech team has done a fantastic job in helping us develop some of our key productivity tools. With limited development resources available in-house, we have been able to roll out new tools and functionalities quickly by working directly with the Scaletech development team on various projects. The quality of their work and diligent technical support have enabled us to expand these development projects at a much faster pace and scale them out further in the future.”

attributes.author: Ralf Baumann
attributes.message: "Back in the Days, we had the challenge to find a trustworthy outsourcing company that we could rely on. Previous attempts ended badly and we needed to find a company that had the skills, good communications, and was fair on price. We choose ScaleTech because we felt that their understood our business needs and had the skills that we needed in development. In the end, this was the best decision we could do, there was a great evolution of the relationship during the years of cooperation and incredible improvement of quality of delivered solutions."
